title: BluBasics
description: A Base mod for my other mods. Adds a mob and some blocks/items.
body:
This is a core mod for my other mods. It adds some stuff but not much that is usable without the other mods. Here are infos on the important things:

Solar Beetle:

  • A passive Mob that spawns in the same biomes as illager towers.
  • They grow their horns with sunlight.
  • Sometimes they stand their wings up to collect more sunlight.
  • Once fully grown can be sheared for beetle horns.
  • If fully grown and in sunlight, the horns will turn golden then can be sheared for sun horns.
  • They can be lured with quartz.

Chimera:

Chimeras are combinations of Foxes, Rabbits, Hoglins, Goats, Chickens, Phantoms and Guardians. They mostly appear already tamed. They don't take fall damage, can shoot beams from their tails and you can give them weapons to hold in their mouths.

Lightning in a Bottle:

A usable item that shoots a lightning arc ad mobs you look at and then breaks.

Mushroom Skewer:

Eatable items that gives sticks back. Normal ones give you levitation and cooked ones fall damage immunity. Each for 5 seconds.

Void Powder:

Can be clicked on light sources with to temporarily turn them into dark voids.

Spine Sapling:

A curio item that lets you walk through leaves. Name it cherry for an alternative look.

Jump Mushroom:

A block that catapults you upwards when walking through it.

Galaxy Spore Mushroom:

A block that gives players around it an illusion effect. It makes you see and hear hostile mobs that are not there.

Player Plushies:

Inspired by the ones on Content SMP. Plush versions of the People that helped me with the mods. right click to squish them, or put them on your head.
